AppealDeck — Visual Direction v2
Inspired by Stripe Atlas, Linear, Ironclad, 1Password.
Same brand green + Inter/JetBrains Mono — new: aurora accents, deeper squircles, duotone icon tiles, split-screen wizard, annotation highlights, an obsidian vault surface.

Added 12 Sep — answers "should we use real screenshots, like Apollo?": yes at concrete product moments, no at generic stock photos (unchanged call). The real UI doesn't carry this visual language yet, so this frame is a labelled sample-data preview, not a real screenshot — swap its contents for a genuine one once V3/V6 build the real pages.
Also this pass: unified the eyebrow-label type scale (11.5/700/uppercase/0.06em) across all five screens — it had drifted to 3 different sizes.
